patterns.note: The site uses a full-width, section-based layout with generous vertical spacing, often featuring large, bold headings that act as visual anchors for each content block.
A dramatic contrast in typography is used, pairing extremely oversized, bold sans-serif headings with elegant, medium-weight serif subheadings and standard sans-serif body text.
A high-contrast black and white palette dominates the design, with a single vibrant cyan used sparingly as an accent for interactive elements and key highlights.

The initial hero features a massive 'WE CRAFT' text that remains fixed in the background while content scrolls over it, creating a layered parallax effect. A circular CTA also initially sticks to the viewport before scrolling away.
The 'WORK' section showcases projects using large, full-bleed video thumbnails that fill the width of the content area, creating an immersive portfolio display.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a fixed background effect for the oversized text, allowing subsequent content to scroll over it, creating a sense of depth. A circular call-to-action element is initially positioned fixed relative to the viewport but is designed to scroll out of view as the user progresses down the page.
The main navigation bar transitions to a sticky state after a short scroll, ensuring persistent access to navigation links.

Sections and content elements are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated using GSAP ScrollTrigger to enhance engagement and guide the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif hero/section headings (~10x body) are contrasted with elegant, medium-weight serif subheadings and standard sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are used for buttons and image containers, maintaining a clean yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a balanced rhythm within content blocks, contributing to a spacious and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost architectural use of typography, particularly the colossal 'WE CRAFT' hero text that acts as a fixed, layered background element. This, combined with the stark black and white palette and single vibrant accent, creates an immediate, memorable, and high-impact visual statement that feels both minimal and powerful.
